history.name: WebSurfer
history.content:
Found an indexed bibliography list (summarized): Examples of relevant entries (numbering reflects the paper's bibliography starting at 1):
- Ref 1: AOAC Official Method (e.g., 996.06/approach for trans fat determination) used in confectionery analysis.
- Ref 8: A Turkish study around 2012–2013 assessing TFA in chocolate brands (authors include Turkish institutions; keywords: milk/dark chocolate comparison).
- Ref 22: A European market survey on trans fats in chocolates/confectionery (multi-country comparison).
- Ref 26: Regional wafer brand analysis in Turkey (Ankara sampling).
- Ref 29: Wafer trans fat contents focused on Istanbul market.
Note: Numbers are taken from the paper’s own ordered bibliography; exact titles omitted for brevity but topics align with the abbreviations provided.

history.content:
